channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Carl Jung — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-16
item.description: “Loneliness does not come from having no people about one, but from being unable to communicate the things that seem important to oneself.” — Carl Jung

item.title: Bruce Lee — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-15
item.description: “Research your own experience, absorb what is useful, reject what is useless, add what is essentially your own.” — Bruce Lee

item.title: Sadhguru — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-14
item.description: “Learning to listen is the essence of intelligent living.” — Sadhguru

item.title: William Blake — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-13
item.description: “In seed time learn, in harvest teach, in winter enjoy.” — William Blake

item.title: Laurence J. Peter — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-12
item.description: “If you don't know where you are going, you will probably end up somewhere else.” — Laurence J. Peter

item.title: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-11
item.description: “Of course I am not worried about intimidating men. The type of man who will be intimidated by me is exactly the type of man I have no interest in.” — Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie

item.title: Plato — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-10
item.description: “Excess of liberty, whether it lies in state or individuals, seems only to pass into excess of slavery.” — Plato

item.title: Blaise Pascal — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-09
item.description: “We do not content ourselves with the life we have in ourselves and in our own being; we desire to live an imaginary life in the mind of others, and for this purpose we endeavour to shine.” — Blaise Pascal
